payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Astrid, Gillian, Reanna, Stefania

payload.content: Hi Astrid, Gillian, Reanna. Coordination for the sprint: I have strong security skill (0.94), so I'm much cheaper on the ISSUE-0002 (security) tasks than the ISSUE-0001 (api-development) ones. I plan to claim ISSUE-0002::review. Could each of you please state your intended task (and whether you also have a security skill match) so we avoid duplicate claims? If someone else is also very cheap on ISSUE-0002 tasks, I can flex to another of the three ISSUE-0002 micro-tasks.

Hi Astrid, Gillian, Stefania — Reanna here. Coordination for the sprint: I have api-development 0.98 (strong) and ui-ux-design 0.90. My lowest-cost task overall is a critical one: ISSUE-0001::triage (cost 2.22). I plan to claim ISSUE-0001::triage. Since we have 4 agents, we can complete at most 4 tasks, so I suggest we prioritize the 5 critical ISSUE-0001 tasks (priority 1.0 each) and only fall back to medium ISSUE-0002 tasks if needed. Please state your intended task so we avoid duplicate claims. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Hi all — Gillian here. My skills: ui-ux-design 0.87, security 0.71. I'm very cost-efficient on ISSUE-0002 (costs 1.12–2.24) but very expensive on ISSUE-0001 api-development tasks (24–60), so I should NOT take a critical ISSUE-0001 task.

My plan: claim ISSUE-0002::test (my cost 1.57). That leaves ISSUE-0002::review for Stefania (she's the security specialist) and ISSUE-0002::implement open.

Reanna: agreed, you (api-dev 0.98) should take ISSUE-0001::triage — that's the best critical-value use of your skill.

Astrid: please state your skills and intended task. If you're strong on api-development, take a critical ISSUE-0001 task (review/docs/test) so we capture more priority-1.0 work; otherwise take ISSUE-0002::implement so we complete all three medium tasks. Either way we avoid duplicates and everyone claims a feasible task. Open to adjusting if someone is cheaper on ISSUE-0002::test than I am.

Hi all — Astrid here. My skills: ui-ux-design 0.72 (no strong api-development or security match). My costs confirm this: ISSUE-0002 (medium) tasks cost me 2.17–4.34, while ISSUE-0001 (critical) tasks cost me 24–60. So I should NOT take a critical api-development task.

Proposed allocation (no duplicates, everyone skill-matched):
- Reanna: ISSUE-0001::triage (critical, her cost 2.22) ✅
- Stefania: ISSUE-0002::review (security specialist) ✅
- Gillian: ISSUE-0002::test (her cost 1.57) ✅
- Astrid (me): ISSUE-0002::implement (my cost 4.34) ✅

This completes 4 tasks (1 critical + 3 medium) with everyone on their cheapest feasible task, minimizing total cost. I'll claim ISSUE-0002::implement unless someone is cheaper on it — please flag if so. (phase=planning, iter=1)

I will claim ISSUE-0002::review in execution. If anyone's cost on review is lower than 1.75, speak now. (phase=planning, iter=1)
